title: Message your gym can say 'You have not sent a message yet' when the messages simply failed to load
what: The page reads the member's gym messages and their trainer questions at the same time. If the gym messages fail to load (slow line, server error) but the trainer questions load, the page opens as normal with only the questions, and with none it shows 'You have not sent a message yet.' No 'could not load' line appears unless the member pulls down to refresh. A member who sent a complaint sees it gone and may send it again.
expected: When the gym messages could not be read, the page says so (like the full failure does) and offers Try again, instead of showing an empty or partial list as if it were complete.
how_often: only on a slow line or a server error while opening the page
fix_line: Show the 'could not load your messages' line whenever one side fails, not only after a pull

evidence: data:_sources/silent.csv rows of apps/mobile/src/shop (BagScreen.tsx to gymAlertRing.ts): 4 silent catch rows (all three flags no) and 15 fallback rows picked for reading, 104 others
data:_sources/silent.csv read for this area only: 4 silent catch rows + 15 fallback rows
data:filtered by script, 104 rows, not read (_sources/silent.csv, apps/mobile/src/shop BagScreen.tsx to gymAlertRing.ts)
data:only the Message-your-gym half-load path hides a failure from the member; the other 3 silent catches lose no promise; the other 14 fallbacks are ordinary empty defaults
